My Interests

I am interested in how internal representations form, stabilize, and change over time. Specifically:

What happens to existing representations when a system incorporates new information? When do transient perturbations become "meaningful"? Under what conditions does representational change become structural reorganization? And importantly, how can these processes be formalized?

I approach these questions through mathematical modeling and computational experiments, focusing on dynamical systems, associative memory, and learning dynamics.

Memory is a natural setting when studying these processes because it requires systems to preserve, modify, and reconstruct existing representations in response to new information. Broadly, I am interested in whether mathematical principles can help describe representational change across systems.
